question: Will Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin meet in person or talk on the phone before January 1, 2027?

calls.reasoning: Not yet resolved: last contact was the Nov 19 Shenzhen meeting, before the window, and no call is reported since Nov 22. Base rate: 2026 inter-contact gaps were ~51, 67, 65, 32 and 40 days; the next contact must come within ~43 days of Nov 19, which roughly 40-50% of gaps meet (2025 gaps were shorter, including late-December calls). G20 at Doral Dec 14-15: Putin invited, Kremlin undecided as of Nov 24, Bloomberg sources say a 'very slim' chance, so ~10-12%. The active peace push favors a call; the meeting just held and stalled talks weigh against one. ~0.11 + 0.89*0.5 = ~0.56-0.57. No market matches: Polymarket and Manifold meeting markets count in-person only and are settled by Shenzhen.
calls.reference_class: Gaps between consecutive Trump-Putin direct contacts (calls/meetings) in 2025-2026

calls.reasoning: No qualifying contact yet reported in window (Shenzhen meeting Nov 19 precedes it). 2026 cadence of Kremlin-reported calls/meetings (Apr 29, mid-Jun, Jul 4-5, Sep 8, Oct 9-10, Nov 19 in person) implies ~1 contact per 35-45 days, giving ~55-60% for the remaining 36 days. Upward: Trump pushing for a Ukraine deal before Democrats take Congress in early January, ongoing Witkoff/Kushner-Dmitriev channel, December 14-15 G20 at Doral with Putin invited (Kremlin: undecided as of Nov 24; prior reporting suggested he'd skip), and Dec 2025 precedent of multiple calls. Downward: Shenzhen yielded nothing, gaps up to 66 days observed. No exactly matching market found; Polymarket 'meet by Dec 31' is satisfied by the Nov 19 meeting and doesn't match.

calls.reasoning: No contact yet counts: the last one was the Nov 19 Shenzhen meeting, before the window opens. In 2026 Trump and Putin had direct contact roughly every 31-66 days (Mar 9, Apr 29, possibly May, Jul 4, Sep 8, Oct 9, Nov 19); only 2 of 5 gaps were short enough to put the next contact inside a window ending 42 days after the last one, a base rate of about 40-50%. Upward: intense Ukraine peace diplomacy (Abu Dhabi talks, Witkoff/Kushner in Moscow Nov 12, Trump saying Putin is 'ready for a deal'), Putin's G20 Doral invitation for Dec 14-15 (Kremlin still undecided Nov 24; in-person chance about 15%), and the precedent of a late-December 2025 call. Downward: Shenzhen produced no deal and was followed by heavy strikes, so a cooling-off period is possible. No matching human market: the Manifold 2026 meeting market at 0.97 is already settled by Shenzhen and does not cover this window.
